use: Choose checks that address the user's objective. Add draft_id and the exact candidate revision to every call. For page views, set the actual one-based section and page. For region_from, copy the indicated native-pixel polygon into arguments.region. Attach rsi_task_id to previews when a task-bound evidence receipt is needed.

paper_and_rulings.inspect: Match the supplied sheet's header, margins and perspective. Compare the actual ink to visible writable rulings at the left, middle and right of occupied rows across the page. Follow next_offset for later glyphs. For explicitly assigned rows, count from the first writable ruling and verify each requested entry against its own slot.
paper_and_rulings.limits: A glyph can follow a ruling exactly and still occupy the wrong named row. Paragraph gaps may be allowed. photo_baseline describes the base layout; inspect current_photo_quad and rendered ink after local edits. Faint or obscured marks can leave placement unresolved.

calls.region_from: A sample's preview_arguments.region in paper_focus_check or local_paper_ink_check when available; otherwise a polygon around nearby writing and a printed mark.

focus_and_contrast.inspect: At native scale compare handwriting edge softness and darkness with nearby printed marks at more than one page depth. Check the photographed paper and the finished crop at the same position.
focus_and_contrast.limits: Weak lines, shadow, stroke width and different printing inks affect both measures. Record insufficient local evidence when a reference cannot be distinguished.

pages_and_delivery.inspect: Repeat the last-page lookup for each requested section. Inspect the first and last required entries, occupied slots, continuation pages and any required page count. At delivery export the selected_revision and compare the returned draft, revision and actual page count with the selection and task.
pages_and_delivery.limits: Last-page lookup may repaginate in the current environment. A full-page review receipt establishes a recorded check. The final PDF and its contents provide the delivery evidence.

calls.region_from: Native polygon enclosing the specific table, its header and the required row and column.

table_cells.inspect: For each requested table identify its title or order, column headings and row keys. Read the required values and units from their individual cells, then check the calculation outside the table against the brief. Follow next_offset for the rest of the source.
table_cells.limits: A correct conclusion, matching row count or well-formed Markdown can coexist with a wrong displayed cell. Mark an unreadable cell unresolved.

calls.region_from: Native polygon enclosing one complete diagram with its arrows, labels and destinations.

diagram_branches.inspect: Check each requested diagram independently. Read every named node. Follow each arrow from its source through its branch label to the destination at the arrowhead. Compare direction, label and destination with the brief.
diagram_branches.limits: Node and diagram counts cannot identify swapped yes/no branches. A whole-drawing layout ID locates a diagram; its rendered arrows and labels supply the visual evidence.
